# Switch

> An on/off setting that takes effect immediately, with a loading state while it saves.

Category: Forms. Docs page: https://rime.mjsons.net/components/switch

## Installation

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add <owner>/rime/switch
```

Switch is role="switch" on a button. Use it for settings that apply at once; use Checkbox inside forms that are submitted.

## Usage

```tsx
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui";

<Switch label="Email me when an invoice is paid" checked={on} onChange={setOn} />
```

## Theme tokens

Per-component tokens. Undeclared by default: the default below is the fallback the CSS uses. Set any of them at :root or on a wrapper to restyle every instance.

| --- | --- |

System tokens it reads: `--brand-gradient`, `--dur`, `--ease`, `--focus-ring`, `--glow-md`, `--glow-sm`, `--ink-body`, `--ink-disabled`, `--ink-muted`, `--r-sm`, `--rgb-brand-deep`, `--rgb-contact`, `--shadow-specular`, `--surface-solid`, `--text-body`, `--text-caption`.

## Accessibility

- aria-checked reflects state; loading sets aria-busy and blocks toggling.

## Do

- Say what is on, not what pressing does: "Email notifications".

## Don't

- Don't use a Switch inside a form that has a submit button.
